title: SafeWebUH at SemEval-2023 Task 11: Learning Annotator Disagreement in Derogatory Text: Comparison of Direct Training vs Aggregation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology of modeling annotator disagreement in derogatory text datasets (such as hate speech and sexism). While the content of these datasets touches upon social ethics and includes a dataset involving Muslim immigrants (HS-Brexit), the paper itself is an evaluation of training strategies (regression on soft labels vs. post-hoc aggregation) rather than a benchmark or evaluation of religious or ethical frameworks.
